newsitem.title: UK: BA may give ground to clinch American deal - paper.
newsitem.headline: BA may give ground to clinch American deal - paper.

text.p: British Airways Plc is negotiating with the UK's Office of Fair Trading (OFT) over new conditions for clearance of its proposed merger with American Airlines, a Sunday newspaper reported.

The alliance may be sealed within the next few months if BA makes further concessions on take-off and landing slots at London's Heathrow airport, heading off opposition from rival carriers, the Independent on Sunday said.
United Airlines has indicated that it would drop its opposition to the link-up if the OFT tightened the conditions it has already imposed on the deal, the newspaper said.
Nobody at British Airways could be reached for comment.
In Chicago, no one was immediately available at the company's headquarters to comment on the report. ((-- London Newsroom +44-171-542-8968))
